item.title: Kuwait thwarts Iranian attack on its soil
item.description:
Kuwait's Interior Ministry revealed Tuesday that four suspects affiliated with Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps had been arrested after attempting to infiltrate the country by sea. During questioning, the suspects admitted that they belonged to Iran's Revolutionary Guards.
